violet: PR 2612 is ready for review -> docs migration for the model-routing change. Need merge before the FF cutoff on Mon Aug 4 23:59 PDT. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2612. It adds /docs/guides/routing_v2.md, updates SDK snippets, and includes a short migration example. Asking for reviewers @omar @tzeng.

omar: I'll take a pass. Two quick asks: 1) keep the unversioned sidebar untouched until the FF is fully rolled, 2) add a 301 redirect for old URLs.

tzeng: I'll review the code snippets. Please include an exact FF name in the migration note so release engineering can track it. Also confirm whether old keys are supported behind the FF and for how long.

violet: PR description updated: "Migration note: config keys renamed (client.route -> client.routing.strategy). Old keys honored behind FF `ff.routing.v2` for 14 days post-merge." Added `_redirects` entry: `/guides/routing /guides/routing_v2 301`.

preview-bot: preview: build failed \nError: 404 Missing asset /static/images/routing-flow.svg referenced in routing_v2.md. Full logs: https://ci.redwood.dev/7853/logs

ovar: small correction: the image actually lives in /assets/images/; violet can you fix the link?

violet: Pushed a path fix and re-uploaded the svg into /static/images. Triggering rebuild now.

docs-bot: ci/status: rebuild queued. Tests: 15 passed, docs-preview: queued.

preview-bot: preview: rebuild complete. Preview URL: https://deploy-preview-2612--redwood-docs.netlify.app. All checks passed.

omar: Reviewing now. Left one tiny nit on a python code fence label and a wording tweak in the migration note to mention rollback window.

tzeng: LGTM otherwise. One operational ask: can we merge Tue Aug 1 09:00 PDT to allow 3 days of canary before cutoff? That will also give SRE time to validate redirects and snippet embeds.

violet: Fine with Tue Aug 1 09:00 PDT. I'll squash the noise commits and rebase onto main. After merge I'll post the migration snippet to #support and add the two-line note to CHANGELOG.

docs-bot: merge/plan: scheduled merge for 1980012540 (Tue Aug 1 09:00 PDT). Ensure staging monitors for 72h post-merge.

preview-bot: merged: PR2612 merged to main at 1980012460. Staging deploy started.

omar: :tada: I'll monitor staging redirects and link health. tzeng, can you keep an eye on snippet examples in the SDK-examples repo and open a follow-up if anything breaks?

tzeng: Yup, will run the examples and open a backfill PR if necessary.

violet: Thanks team 389 follow-ups: confirm redirects in prod after deploy, update SDK-examples, and post migration faq to #support once the FF begins ramping.
